-- The results look correct. Let me verify by manually checking one case:
-- Pallet of L (531) -> Box Large (521, qty 12) -> Bottle 500cl (502, qty 72)
-- Total = 12 * 72 = 864 ✓

-- Pallet of M (532) -> Box Medium (522, qty 20) -> Bottle 330cl (501, qty 36)
-- Total = 20 * 36 = 720 ✓

-- Pallet Mix MS (533) -> Box Small (523, qty 20) -> Bottle 500cl (502, qty 30)
-- Total = 20 * 30 = 600 ✓
-- Also: 533 -> Box Medium (522, qty 10) -> Bottle 330cl (501, qty 36) = 360 (not > 500)

-- Pallet Mix SG (534) -> Box Small (523, qty 20) -> Bottle 500cl (502, qty 30) = 600
-- Pallet Mix SG (534) -> Gift Box (524, qty 16) -> Gift Carton (511, qty 8) -> Bottle 500cl (502, qty 2) = 16*8*2 = 256
-- Total for 534 -> 502 = 600 + 256 = 856 ✓
-- Pallet Mix SG (534) -> Gift Box (524, qty 16) -> Gift Carton (511, qty 8) -> Bottle 330cl (501, qty 3) = 16*8*3 = 384 (not > 500)

-- The results look correct! Let me also check if Pallet Mix SG -> Box Small -> Bottle 330cl exists
-- 523 only contains 502, so no path from 534 through 523 to 501. Good.

-- The answer is complete. Let me format it properly without the .0 decimal issue
WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_container_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS cumulative_qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN pr.contains_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations) 
            THEN pr.contains_id 
            ELSE NULL 
        END AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (
        SELECT p.id FROM packaging p
        WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        h.top_container_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.cumulative_qty * pr.qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN pr.contains_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations) 
            THEN pr.contains_id 
            ELSE h.leaf_id 
        END
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
    WHERE h.leaf_id IS NULL
)
SELECT 
    tc.name AS top_container_name,
    lc.name AS leaf_item_name,
    CAST(SUM(h.cumulative_qty) AS BIGINT) AS total_quantity
FROM hierarchy h
JOIN packaging tc ON h.top_container_id = tc.id
JOIN packaging lc ON h.leaf_id = lc.id
WHERE h.leaf_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY tc.name, lc.name, h.top_container_id, h.leaf_id
HAVING SUM(h.cumulative_qty) > 500
ORDER BY tc.name, lc.name

{"sql": "-- So leaves are Bottle 330cl (501) and Bottle 500cl (502).
-- Now I need to trace the hierarchy from each top-level container down to these leaf items.
-- For each top-level container, I need to find all leaf items it contains (directly or indirectly)
-- and compute the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels.

-- The hierarchy looks like:
-- 531 (Pallet of L) -> 521 (Box Large, qty 12) -> 502 (Bottle 500cl, qty 72)
-- 532 (Pallet of M) -> 522 (Box Medium, qty 20) -> 501 (Bottle 330cl, qty 36)
-- 533 (Pallet Mix MS) -> 523 (Box Small, qty 20) -> 502 (Bottle 500cl, qty 30)
-- 533 (Pallet Mix MS) -> 522 (Box Medium, qty 10) -> 501 (Bottle 330cl, qty 36)
-- 534 (Pallet Mix SG) -> 524 (Gift Box, qty 16) -> 511 (Gift Carton, qty 8) -> {502 (qty 2), 501 (qty 3)}
-- 534 (Pallet Mix SG) -> 523 (Box Small, qty 20) -> 502 (Bottle 500cl, qty 30)

-- I need a recursive CTE to traverse the hierarchy and compute cumulative quantities

WITH RECURSIVE hierarchy AS (
    -- Base: top-level containers containing their direct children
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS top_container_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS cumulative_qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (
        SELECT p.id FROM packaging p
        WHERE p.id NOT IN (SELECT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    )
    UNION ALL
    -- Recursive: follow the chain down
    SELECT 
        h.top_container_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        h.cumulative_qty * pr.qty,
        CASE 
            WHEN pr.contains_id NOT IN (SELECT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations) 
            THEN pr.contains_id 
            ELSE h.leaf_id 
        END
    FROM hierarchy h
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON h.current_id = pr.packaging_id
)
SELECT * FROM hierarchy ORDER BY top_container_id, leaf_id"}
